title: Printing Books in Small Batches
transcript:
A small printing business on River Road has found new customers by producing fewer books at a time. I spoke to its owner, Melissa Grant, who said that local clubs and writers often wanted fifty copies rather than several thousand. With older equipment, preparing the machines for such a small order cost almost as much as printing the books themselves.

A new digital printer has changed that balance. It allows the business to print a small batch, correct a mistake, and produce more copies later without repeating a long preparation process. Melissa said this was particularly useful for community history groups, which sometimes received new photographs or corrections after neighbours saw the first edition.

I asked if faster printing meant customers could skip checking their work. Melissa laughed and described a sports club that nearly printed last year's contact details in its anniversary booklet. Her team had noticed the date, but she said the customer remained responsible for confirming the information. Every order now includes a single sample copy for approval before the rest are printed.

The new machine has not removed all the slower work. Staff still check page order and trim the finished books carefully. Melissa thinks the main benefit is flexibility rather than speed alone. Writers can test interest with a modest order and avoid filling a spare room with unsold copies. If demand grows, the printer can supply another batch using the approved file.

questions.prompt: What difficulty did small orders create with the older equipment?
options: The machines could print photographs but no words.
Preparing the machines was expensive compared with printing a small batch.
Customers had to supply their own paper.
Only sports clubs were allowed to place orders.
questions.answer: Preparing the machines was expensive compared with printing a small batch.
questions.explanation: 老设备的准备成本很高，小批量印刷时这一成本几乎与印书本身相当。

questions.prompt: Why is the new printer useful for community history groups?
options: It can find missing photographs automatically.
It guarantees that historical information is correct.
It allows updates before another small batch is produced.
It writes descriptions of every local building.
questions.answer: It allows updates before another small batch is produced.
questions.explanation: 历史团体收到新照片或更正后，可以修改文件，再印下一小批。

questions.prompt: What must happen before a full order is printed?
options: The club must sell every planned copy.
The printer must advertise the book online.
Neighbours must attend a public meeting.
The customer must approve a sample copy.
questions.answer: The customer must approve a sample copy.
questions.explanation: 每个订单现在先出一本样书，客户确认后才印其余部分。

questions.prompt: What does Melissa see as the main advantage of the new service?
options: Customers can test demand without storing many unsold books.
Staff no longer need to inspect the finished books.
Every book can be produced without customer input.
Writers can stop keeping a copy of their files.
questions.answer: Customers can test demand without storing many unsold books.
questions.explanation: 小批量服务更灵活，作者可先测试需求，避免家中积压大量未售书籍。
